spots=[('athens','~/photographs/vacations/athens/'),('maui','~/photographs/vacations/maui/'),('stockholm','~/photographs/vacations/stockholm/'),('tokyo','~/photographs/vacations/tokyo/')]
results=[]
for spot,dir_path in spots:
    zip_path=f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip'
    try:
        r=apis.file_system.compress_directory(
            access_token=access_token,
            directory_path=dir_path,
            compressed_file_path=zip_path,
            delete_directory=True,
            overwrite=False
        )
        # verify
        zip_exists=apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token,file_path=zip_path)['exists']
        dir_exists=apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=access_token,directory_path=dir_path)['exists']
        results.append((spot,'ok',r,'zip_exists',zip_exists,'dir_exists',dir_exists))
        print('compressed',spot,'->',r,'zip_exists:',zip_exists,'dir_exists:',dir_exists)
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((spot,'fail',str(e)))
        print('fail',spot,':',e)
print('results:',results)
